# Wispr Flow

# Get a meeting
Source: https://developers.wisprflow.ai/api-reference/meetings/get-a-meeting

/openapi.json get /public/v1/admin/meetings/{meeting_id}
Get one meeting with its published summary, linked calendar event and attendees.

The same visibility rules as the list endpoint apply. Meetings that do not exist and meetings the organization
cannot see both return 404.

# Get a transcript
Source: https://developers.wisprflow.ai/api-reference/meetings/get-a-transcript

/openapi.json get /public/v1/admin/meetings/{meeting_id}/transcript
Get the final transcript of one meeting, with speakers named.

Requires both `admin:meetings:read` and `admin:meetings:transcripts:read`. The same visibility rules as the
list endpoint apply: a meeting the organization cannot see returns 404, the same as one that does not exist.
For a visible meeting, the response says why a transcript is withheld: 403 when the organization shares notes
without transcripts or the meeting's owner is covered by a HIPAA business associate agreement, 410 when it was
deleted under a retention policy, and 409 while the meeting is still processing. Successful reads are recorded
in the organization's audit log.

# List meetings
Source: https://developers.wisprflow.ai/api-reference/meetings/list-meetings

/openapi.json get /public/v1/admin/meetings
List the organization's meetings, newest first.

Returns meetings that are opted in to organization insights and whose owner currently belongs to the API key's
organization. Deleted meetings are excluded, and nothing is returned while the organization has organization
insights turned off. Results are ordered by `created_at`, newest first. When `next_cursor` is not null, pass it as `cursor` to fetch the next page; a null
`next_cursor` means there are no more results.

# Wispr Flow Enterprise API
Source: https://developers.wisprflow.ai/index

Bring your organization's Wispr Flow meetings into your own tools.

The Wispr Flow Enterprise API gives organization admins programmatic access to the meetings their members share through organization insights. Use it to bring meeting summaries, transcripts, calendar details and attendees into the tools your teams already use.

The API is a REST API served from `https://api.wisprflow.ai`. Every endpoint is read-only, and every response is JSON.

## Authentication

Wispr enables the Enterprise API for each organization. To get an API key, reach out to your Wispr representative.

> [!NOTE]
>
> Treat your API key like a password. Keep it in a secrets manager or environment variable, and never put it in source control or in code that runs in a browser or mobile app.

Send your API key as a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header of every request:

| Header | Value |
| - | - |
| `Authorization` | `Bearer <api_key>` |

The meetings endpoints require a key with the `admin:meetings:read` permission. Transcripts also require the `admin:meetings:transcripts:read` permission, so a key that reads transcripts needs both. A missing or invalid key returns `401`, and a key without the required permissions returns `403`.

## Make your first request

List the ten most recent meetings in your organization:

```bash theme={null}
curl "https://api.wisprflow.ai/public/v1/admin/meetings?page_size=10" \
  --header "Authorization: Bearer $WISPR_API_KEY"
```

The response contains a page of `meetings`, newest first, and a `next_cursor` for the next page. Pass a meeting's `id` to [Get a meeting](/api-reference/meetings/get-a-meeting) for its summary, calendar event and attendees.

## Transcripts

[Get a transcript](/api-reference/meetings/get-a-transcript) returns a meeting's final transcript as a list of spoken turns, each with a speaker, a start time and the text. Corrections the meeting's owner made to the transcript are included. A transcript is available only after the meeting has finished processing.

When a transcript isn't available, the response says why:

| Status | Reason |
| - | - |
| `403` | Your organization shares notes without transcripts, or the meeting is covered by a HIPAA business associate agreement. |
| `409` | The meeting is still processing. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay. |
| `410` | The transcript was deleted under your organization's retention policy. |

A meeting your organization can't see returns `404`, the same as one that doesn't exist. Each successful transcript read is recorded in your organization's audit log.

## Pagination

List endpoints return up to `page_size` results per page: 50 by default and at most 100. When more results exist, the response includes a `next_cursor`. Pass it as the `cursor` parameter, with the same filters, to get the next page. On the last page, `next_cursor` is `null`.

## Rate limits

Rate limits apply to your whole organization, and all of its API keys share them. By default, an organization can make 5 requests per second. To change your organization's limit, reach out to your Wispr representative.

When you exceed the limit, the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header: the number of seconds to wait before retrying. Wait at least that long before sending the request again.

## Errors

Errors return a JSON body with a `detail` field that describes the problem.

| Status | Meaning |
| - | - |
| `400` | The filters or cursor are invalid. |
| `401` | The API key is missing, invalid, expired or revoked, or your organization's API access isn't enabled. |
| `403` | The API key doesn't have the permission this endpoint requires, or your organization's policy withholds a transcript. |
| `404` | The meeting doesn't exist or isn't visible to your organization. |
| `408` | The request didn't finish within the server's deadline. |
| `409` | The transcript isn't ready yet. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay. |
| `410` | The transcript was deleted under your organization's retention policy. |
| `422` | A parameter is the wrong type or out of range, such as a meeting ID that isn't a UUID, or a transcript is too large to return in one response. Don't retry an oversized transcript. |
| `429` | Your organization's rate limit is exhausted. Retry after the `Retry-After` delay. |
| `503` | A dependency is temporarily unavailable. Retry with exponential backoff. |
